method: NMOS Fig8a small-signal resistance at V(P)=1uV; monotonic interpolation in one nominal control sweep. Sizes are assumed, not paper. Control is derived missing implementation data, not filter optimization.
vbias_rationale: Unpublished front-end VBias chosen as VSS +0.6V (nominal threshold about0.4V plus0.2V overdrive). No target fitting.
